spans.s:
Uṣyala occurs once in the description of the couch or the bridal car in the Atharvaveda, where it seems to mean the four ‘frame-pieces.’ The form is doubtful: uṣpala is possible.
Foot notes xiv. 1, 60.
Whitney, Translation of the Atharvaveda, 385.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 155; Whitney, op. cit., 752.
